cases.sentence: Что золотая серьга или из ___ украшение,
cases.explain: «чистого золота» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

cases.explain: «жатвенный зной» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

cases.explain: «острая стрела» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

cases.explain: «холодный день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

cases.explain: «Северный ветер» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

cases.explain: «холодная вода» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

cases.explain: «мутный ключ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
